# api.yaml reference

The overlay file, one per folder under `apis/`: the API contract (direction, semantic types, exposed names and more) over the PCML call contract. Generated from its JSON Schema.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `pcml` | string | PCML file, relative to this file. |
| `version` | string |  |
| `title` | string | Title of the API in the OpenAPI document; the API name (the folder name, lower-cased) when absent. |
| `call` | auto or pcml or raw |  |
| `program` | string |  |
| `id` | string |  |
| `route` | string |  |
| `method` | GET or POST or PUT or PATCH or DELETE |  |
| `summary` | string |  |
| `description` | string |  |
| `tags` | array |  |
| `inject` | object | Parameters filled by the runtime: a literal, or ${environment.&lt;name&gt;} / ${tenant.&lt;name&gt;}. |
| `parameters` | object |  |
| `error` | object |  |
| `error.when` | object |  |
| `error.when.field` | string |  |
| `error.when.equals` | string or number or boolean |  |
| `error.when.notEquals` | string or number or boolean |  |
| `error.when.in` | array |  |
| `error.code` | string |  |
| `error.message` | string |  |
| `error.httpStatus` | integer |  |
| `error.statusByCode` | object |  |
| `cache` | object |  |
| `cache.ttlSeconds` | integer |  |
| `operations` | array |  |

One overlay file per folder under apis/. Common form: route and method at the top level. Several operations: an operations list. The loader applies further rules that a schema cannot express (for example that a parameter exists in the PCML).

## Complete example

```yaml
program: ORDSTATUS
pcml: ORDSTATUS.pcml
route: /orders/{orderNumber}/status
method: GET
version: 1.0.0
summary: Returns the status of a purchase order

inject:
  P0ENV: ${environment.code}

parameters:
  P0ORDN: { name: orderNumber, type: integer, pad: left, padChar: "0" }
  P0STAT: { name: status }
  P0DATE: { name: deliveryDate, type: date, format: yyyyMMdd }
  P0ERR: { direction: internal }
  P0ERRC: { direction: internal }
  P0XERR: { direction: internal }

error:
  when: { field: P0ERR, equals: "KO" }
  code: P0ERRC
  message: P0XERR
  httpStatus: 422
  statusByCode: { E404: 404 }
```
